quote: Every document in the deal package is governed by New York law and submits to the exclusive jurisdiction of New York County courts, **except** the TSA, which selects **Delaware** law and **Delaware** courts (TSA § 9.3).
reason: Issue 3 covers most of the criterion: it flags the Delaware vs. New York conflict, warns that the same facts could produce different results in an APA claim and a TSA claim, and recommends conforming the TSA to New York law and New York County courts. It never explains that APA § 10.12 lets the TSA control as to its own subject matter, so the conflict is not cured. Issue 7 discusses § 10.12 only in relation to the Bill of Sale's 'Purchased Assets' definition, not the TSA's governing law clause. That required element is missing, so the criterion is not met.
